rows.grounds: demonstrative referring to previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound object describing concealed essential being
main verb indicating manifestation of omniscience

items.question: What state arises from knowing that hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a transformative act.
All-knowingness is presented as a resulting state.
items.inference: Knowing that hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The precise referent of taṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
